values.note: 2027 on the booking site: 20/30-amp sites $30 Sunday-Thursday, $33 Friday-Saturday; the six full-hookup sites $45 / $48. 2026: $28 and $43 on the booking site (the DNR rates table gives $28 for 20/30-amp and $38 for full hookup). A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry.

values.note: 156 campsites on the booking maps (the DNR page says 158): North Loop 77, South Loop 79. Allowed equipment 25-45 ft at 148 sites (45 ft at 15) and 20 ft at 8; pull-throughs at sites 9, 11, 19, 20, 36, 99 and 134. Six North Loop sites have full hookups.

values.note: Sanitation station with potable water and two lanes, behind the contact station; the toilet/shower building is open for the whole reservable season. Kayak and canoe rentals at the contact station.

values.note: Reserve online on MiDNRReservations or at 800-447-2757; the DNR rates table gives a reservation season of May 1 to November 29 for the campground, the mini cabin and the lodge. The group-use area is booked by calling the park (989-539-3021).

note: Modern campground of Wilson State Park (Michigan DNR) at the north end of Budd Lake in Harrison (910 N. First Street), on the site of the 1800s Wilson Brothers sawmill; north and south loops, most sites generous in size and shaded by oaks, maples and pines, near the swim beach and picnic area. The Leota ORV Trailhead is nearby. --Claude
